_meta.purpose: Durable master-data mapping for writing an ERP Sales Order back into AutoCount (HOUZS CENTURY [LIVE]) as an AutoCount Sales Order. Company 1 (Houzs Century) only; 2990 excluded. Harvested read-only from AutoCount 2.2 maintenance screens on 2026-08-06.
_meta.source: AutoCount Accounting 2.2 64-bit, HOUZS CENTURY SDN BHD [LIVE], user ADMIN
notes: AutoCount has NO create-SO endpoint yet; the .NET middleware only exposes updateFromSheet + update-udf-dates. Writeback needs a new AutoCount-SDK create path. This file is the data that path will consume.
Never write AutoCount accounting tables via raw SQL; go through the AutoCount SDK/UI so business logic runs.
DocNo strategy: AutoCount document is populated directly from what we write, so the ERP doc_no becomes the AutoCount DocNo directly (owner confirmed 2026-08-06).

THE FOUR MAPS BELOW ARE THE SOURCE OF TRUTH AND THE COMPILED ONES ARE GENERATED FROM THEM (2026-08-14). `node scripts/gen-autocount-master-maps.mjs` writes src/services/autocount-master-maps.ts, which autocount-writeback.ts re-exports as AGENT_MAP / LOCATION_MAP / VENUE_MAP / BRANDING_MAP; `npm run audit:ac-master-maps` fails CI if the two disagree. Until that date the maps were hand-written TypeScript and this file was a 2026-08-06 harvest note beside it, and the two had already drifted apart in every dimension — the TS carried ETHAN/WEI PIN (confirmed out of agent_map_fuzzy_to_confirm and never written back here), five identity location entries, and ZANOTTI/NONE/CARRESS/DUNLOP. Confirming a new binding is now an edit to THIS file plus the generator, never an edit to TypeScript.

KEYS ARE UPPERCASE because `bookSpelling` looks a value up by `norm()` — uppercased, whitespace-collapsed. A mixed-case key can only ever be reached through the value loop, so `"Shi Ting": "Chang Shi Ting"` matched nothing while `"SHI TING"` matches. The generator uppercases and refuses a collision.

debtor.rule: Every writeback SO uses DebtorCode=300-C002 and overwrites DebtorName with the actual customer name (free text). No per-customer debtor alignment needed.

line.composed_variants_description: ItemDescription (Description 2) — the full composed variant string

payment.note: SO is non-financial in AutoCount. PAYEMENT UDF (free text, e.g. receipt ref) + SOUDF_BALANCE carry info only; real receipts are a separate AR document + endpoint that does not exist.

branding_note: HOUZS was ADDED to the AutoCount BRANDING UDF list on 2026-08-06 (via User Defined List Maintenance UI). THIS MAP IS AN ALLOW-LIST — the only one of the four — because its ERP source column holds CATEGORIES, not brands: a pass-through would have opened `2990s Sofa`, `Accessories`, `2990s Mattress`, `2990`, `Bedframe` and `Happi.S` as permanent brands in the licensed book (PR #2200, measured). A matcher may PROPOSE an addition here; it may never turn this into a pass-through.
autocount_branding_options_note: The BRANDING UDF option list. The first seven are the 2026-08-06 harvest from User Defined List Maintenance; CARRESS and DUNLOP were added on 2026-08-14 because the live book's own SO history uses them (7 SOs in the 2026-08-11 export) — they exist as options whether or not the maintenance screen was re-read. Structured rather than prose so the binding report can answer 'is this already a master' for branding the way it does for the other three.
location_note: AutoCount SalesLocation uses SHORT codes; ERP uses long/free-text. JB & Kuantan have no dedicated AutoCount location and fall in the KL/Balakong delivery region per the ERP postcode->zone model (zone-classify.ts); KL warehouse serves central/south/east, PG serves the north, SBH=Sabah. BOUND 2026-08-15: the 11 scm.warehouses codes the alignment report called unknown are the SAME PHYSICAL PLACES the book already holds under short codes — SHOWROOM/DISPLAY/SERVICE against SUNWAY/KL DISP/SERV KL and so on. Every target is checked against autocount_locations_reference at generation time. Left unbound: CHINA WAREHOUSE, which the book genuinely does not have. Without these, /ensure-masters opens a duplicate and one physical place's stock is split across two rows in a licensed book — SBH WAREHOUSE alone carries 246 orders.

venue_map.SULTAN AHMAD SHAH CONVENTION CENTRE: SULTAN AHMAD SHAH CONVENTION CENTRE SASICC

venue_note: AutoCount SOUDF_VENUE is a controlled dropdown of ~95 options. ERP venue strings normalise to the AC option (naming differs by SOLO suffix / spelling). Full AC venue list captured in autocount-venue-options.txt if needed. CONFIRMED 2026-08-15: 25 pairs added from the matcher report — the owner ruled on MID VALLEY (KL, the exhibition centre, NOT Southkey JB), PISA and PAVILION; the rest differ only by a SOLO suffix or a spelling the book fixed differently. NOT bound, deliberately: AUTO CITY and SUNSHINE CENTRAL each have two plausible masters and no ruling, so they open as new options — a visible extra option beats filing orders silently under the wrong venue. WORLD TRADE CENTRE KUALA LUMPUR is not KLCC; different halls. 2026-08-15, second pass: the 20 remaining CONFIDENT pairs bound — 19 are the book's SOLO suffix and one is word order (STADIUM BUKIT JALIL / BUKIT JALIL STADIUM). Every target verified against autocount-venue-options.txt. Nine venues genuinely absent from the book stay unbound and open on first use, per the owner's rule: real convention centres (MELAKA INTERNATIONAL TRADE CENTRE, SETIA CITY CONVENTION CENTRE, MITEC, AUSTIN INTERNATIONAL CONVENTION CENTRE and five more).
agent_map_note: AGENT and SALESPERSON are ONE AutoCount dimension: `resolveAcAgent` feeds the single `SalesAgent` field from `mfg_sales_orders.agent` through this map, else `scm.staff.name` through this map, else the staff name AS ITSELF for /ensure-masters to open. The raw `agent` text never passes through unmapped (production rows hold bare uuids). The PURCHASE agent is a DIFFERENT AutoCount master table (dbo.PurchaseAgent) and a constant, AC_PURCHASE_AGENT — do not map into it from here. `Ethan` -> `ETHAN SOO` and `Wei Pin` -> `WEIPIN` moved out of agent_map_fuzzy_to_confirm on 2026-08-14 because the compiled map has carried them since PR #2148; this file was simply never told. CONFIRMED 2026-08-15: Louis -> LOUIS WONG and Lim -> WEI SIANG are the owner's rulings ('Lim' and 'Lim Wei Siang' are one person); Weng Gi -> WENGGI is the book writing it as one word.

agent_excluded_note: This list is NOT a gate — nothing in the composer reads it. It is the record of a decision, and check-autocount-master-bindings.mjs prints any live ERP salesperson that LOOKS like a test account and is not on it, as a decision for the owner rather than a silent addition.

sofa.rule: AutoCount holds ONE stock item per sofa MODEL per supplier (SET UOM, e.g. DSL-8038 SOFA, AMN-SF9028 SOFA, HOK-5530 SOFA). Our per-compartment ERP SKUs (8030-2S, 9028-L(RHF)...) collapse to the parent AutoCount code for the line's SUPPLIER, with the compartment (2L, 3S, CNR...) written into Description 2. No per-compartment AutoCount items exist.
